description: This file defines the UserDictionary class, which manages user-specific dictionaries for an Android keyboard application. It handles loading, suggestions, validation, addition, and deletion of words, and manages fallback mechanisms for dictionary loading failures.

classes.name: UserDictionary
classes.description: A class that manages a user-specific dictionary, supporting loading, suggestions, validation, and modification of words, with fallback mechanisms.

methods.name: getLoadedWords
methods.description: Retrieves loaded words from the actual dictionary via callback.

methods.name: getSuggestions
methods.description: Provides suggestions for a given key code provider and callback.

methods.name: getUserNextWordGetter
methods.description: Returns the NextWordDictionary instance used for next word suggestions.

methods.name: isValidWord
methods.description: Checks if a word is valid in the current dictionary.

methods.name: loadAllResources
methods.description: Loads the necessary dictionaries, with fallback if the primary load fails.

methods.name: createFallbackUserDictionary
methods.description: Creates a fallback user dictionary instance.

methods.name: createAndroidUserDictionary
methods.description: Creates an Android-specific user dictionary instance.

methods.name: addWord
methods.description: Adds a word with a specified frequency to the dictionary.

methods.name: deleteWord
methods.description: Deletes a word from the dictionary.

methods.name: getActualDictionary
methods.description: Returns the current active dictionary instance.
